pageDescription: Explore Downtown Vancouver, Stanley Park and Science World in an original interactive 3D city built from geographic data, with terrain, buildings, beaches and parks.
exploreIntro: A city between forest, mountains and sea.
movementHelp: W / S move · A / D turn
orbitHelp: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to pan
streetNotice: W/S move · A/D turn · Drag to look · Esc to return to orbit
aboutIntro: An original browser city built from geographic data.
aboutBody: Explore Downtown, Stanley Park and Science World, following real coastlines, city blocks and park slopes. Fly above the city, walk or drive its streets, adjust the light and save a landscape.
terrainBody: Interpolated from the City’s 2002 contours on an approximately 20 m grid. Stanley Park’s high ground reaches about 76 m.
buildingsBody: Measured 2009 building parts combined with OpenStreetMap height records. Recognizable landmarks use original parametric models.
detailBody: Street-tree locations use open data. Forest canopy, façades, vehicles, lighting and signs are visual approximations rather than photographic reproductions.
licenseBody: Original code and modeling: MIT. Geographic data retain the OGL Vancouver and ODbL licenses.
loadFailed: The map could not finish loading
loadingDetails: Real terrain · City skyline · Pacific coast
loadErrorDetail: Some map assets could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the map.

canvasLabel: Interactive 3D Vancouver map. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom and right-drag to pan.

view.overview.name: The peninsula

view.lions.name: Lions Gate
